task_title: Stale-while-revalidate listings for the shared Azure resource cache

plan_review.notes: 4 concerns: (1) blocking - purge not gated on confirmed cache.set() write, fixed by capturing the boolean return and early-returning before purge; (2) non-blocking - unbounded inner.list() can pin the dedup slot forever, documented as an accepted/monitored risk in the ADR (mirrors a pre-existing hang risk in the old blocking path; a proper fix needs RunStore-wide AbortSignal plumbing, out of scope for 3 apples); (3) non-blocking - purge only cleared blob: entries not per-run derived caches, fixed by reusing the existing removePerRunSnapshotOnRunRemoval() helper in the purge loop; (4) non-blocking - no test proved a same-process mutation racing an in-flight background refresh prevents publishing stale data, added a dedicated race test using a GatedListStore + put() mid-flight.
